text:
maya: Heads-up: staging canary is blocked, deploy-bot reports prefetch cache failure on latest build 2026-03-23-1420. link: https://ci.example.com/builds/5821
ravi: saw that, logs show 504 from artifact-store during multipart prefetch. short snippet:
```
GET /artifacts/sha256:abc123/prefetch -> 504 Gateway Timeout
curl exit 28
```
deploy-bot: auto-retry attempted (3/3) and failed; canary promotion paused.
tess: ok — is this a transient storage issue or corrupt artifact? we need decision for change-window at 15:00PT.
omar: quick triage: if it's transient, we can wait 30m and retry; if artifact missing/corrupt we must pin to last-good image (sha256:def456) and cut release notes.
ravi: storage team says spike in GET latency around 14:18 due to GC job; most objects retrievable now but multipart prefetch still times out for that shard.
sre-oncall: recommend manual promote of previous digest to avoid missing window. pinging storage for verify.
maya: timeline: 14:25 decide -> manual promote? or roll forward after reupload?
omar: opt to promote last-good image for prod canary to meet SLAs. action: @deploy-bot please promote image sha256:def456 to canary and keep current build in quarantine.
deploy-bot: received promote command, starting: `deploybot promote --env canary --image sha256:def456 --reason "prefetch artifact 5821 timeout"`
deploy-bot: promote succeeded, canary now on sha256:def456, routing updated.
tess: thanks — I'll update release notes and backlog ticket. please capture postmortem if storage root cause confirmed. :thumbsup:
ravi: follow-up: storage will rehydrate the missing shard and re-run prefetch; we can re-run the build/test pipeline against rebuilt artifacts later.
maya: closing for now. tagging release-window as met. will open an incident if reoccurs.
